text: Completed trusted-recording audit. Recording.of and BinocularRecording.of now reject indexed non-finite positions, false Tracked outside frame, false OffScreen inside frame, non-finite/non-positive pupils, and pupil values without declared units; fixed-rate construction proves every gap against its nominal period under SamplingTolerance and retains SamplingEvidence, while irregular input is explicit. Final content hash is 00b93d68abd7b46f on both platforms; workflow SHA-256 golden intentionally moved to 2111be4766b5170634c120ef8e0722274fbb1b726ee9a1e52c673041f5f8726a.
